import { clerkMiddleware, createRouteMatcher } from '@clerk/nextjs/server'

const isAdminRoute = createRouteMatcher(['/admin(.*)'])
// Only gate genuinely sensitive mutation/ingest endpoints. The read-only AI
// query routes (/api/disclosure/*, /api/prometheus/chat) power the public
// research canvas and must stay reachable without a Clerk session — there is
// no sign-in flow wired into that UI yet (see CLAUDE.md: "all routes publicly
// accessible"). Add them back here once auth is surfaced in the canvas.
const isProtectedApiRoute = createRouteMatcher([
  '/api/processing(.*)',
])
const isPublicApiRoute = createRouteMatcher([
  '/api/webhooks(.*)',
  '/api/cron(.*)',
])

export default clerkMiddleware(async (auth, req) => {
  // Skip auth for webhooks and cron endpoints (they use secret verification)
  if (isPublicApiRoute(req)) {
    return
  }

  // Protect admin routes - require authentication
  if (isAdminRoute(req)) {
    await auth.protect()
    return
  }

  // Protect API routes - require authentication
  if (isProtectedApiRoute(req)) {
    await auth.protect()
    return
  }
})

## A. Workspace facts

| Fact | Location |
|------|----------|
| Stack | Next.js 15 (`next` ^15.5), React 19, Bun, Tailwind 4, Clerk, `@db/postgres`, Vercel AI SDK + OpenAI Assistants |
| Product surface | Research canvas / mindmap / spacetime under `apps/app/src/features/{mindmap,spacetime}` |
| Live AI only | `/api/disclosure/mindmap`, `/api/prometheus/chat` — pinned in [`apps/app/CLAUDE.md`](apps/app/CLAUDE.md) |
| Nested CLAUDE | [`apps/app/CLAUDE.md`](apps/app/CLAUDE.md) (route→ViewSwitcher map, Zustand, auth gap) |
| Test | `bun test src` (pkg) / root `bun run test:app` |
| Dev | root `bun run dev:app` → `apps/app` `next dev` |
| Format | Prettier **only** at [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc) (no semicolons, singleQuote, printWidth 100, `bracketSpacing: false`) |
| Lint | [`apps/app/.eslintrc`](apps/app/.eslintrc) + `next lint` |
| Env/secrets | [`apps/app/.env`](apps/app/.env), [`apps/app/.env.local`](apps/app/.env.local); DB URL also [`packages/db/.env`](packages/db/.env). Keys include Clerk, Mapbox, OpenAI/assistant IDs, Xata leftovers, TipTap, Supabase |
| Auth reality | [`apps/app/src/middleware.ts`](apps/app/src/middleware.ts): Clerk on `/admin`, `/api/processing`; AI + most APIs public by design |
| DoD | [`.agents/rules/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`](.agents/rules/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md) — evidence report + visual dogfood |
| GOAL.md | **Missing** at repo root and `apps/app/` (proposal’s SessionStart target doesn’t exist yet) |
| MCP now | [`.mcp.json`](.mcp.json): context7, chrome-devtools, openai-vector-store; DeepGraph listed but disabled in `settings.local.json` |
| Hooks live | [`.claude/settings.json`](.claude/settings.json): SessionStart dumps AGENTS/TODO/DAILY (2k each); `block-new-docs.sh` only in [`.claude/hooks/hooks.json`](.claude/hooks/hooks.json), **not** wired into `settings.json` |

API tree (17 routes): disclosure/{mindmap,uap-sightings}, prometheus/chat, mindmap/records, documents/*, processing/*, cron/*, sightings/realtime, client-logs, webhooks/xata — see [`apps/app/src/app/api`](apps/app/src/app/api). [`docs/architecture/API_ROUTES.md`](docs/architecture/API_ROUTES.md) is stale on “no Clerk middleware.”

---

## B. Real DX failures here

1. **Invented AI / RAG routes** — stale plans still pitch `/api/rag/*` ([`apps/app/docs/RAG_TIPTAP_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`](apps/app/docs/RAG_TIPTAP_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md)); agents ignore “only two live paths.”
2. **Wrong mental model / paths** — root AGENTS still says R-Tree; nested CLAUDE corrects to bounding-box `useProximityAnalysis`. Thin `(site)/` wrappers ≠ UI; must hit `ViewSwitcher`.
3. **Skipped dogfood** — DoD origin story: green tests, never opened canvas; Mapbox missing → silent placeholder globe.
4. **Token burn** — SessionStart injects ~6k of AGENTS+TODO+DAILY (~214KB sources); no `GOAL.md` / branch / dirty list.
5. **Shared-tree stash** — documented 2026-07-12 incident; guardrail script exists ([`.devin/skills/.../block-dangerous-git.sh`](.devin/skills/git-guardrails-claude-code/scripts/block-dangerous-git.sh)) but not in live hooks.
6. **Format fights** — Prettier is app-local (`bracketSpacing: false`); repo-wide format will thrash.
7. **Auth doc drift** — agents “fix” public AI routes or claim zero middleware; middleware intentionally leaves them open.
8. **`block-new-docs` half-dead** — script exists; not in active `settings.json` PreToolUse.

---

## C. Verdict on the 6 proposals

| # | Item | Verdict | Why |
|---|------|---------|-----|
| 1 | MCP Neon + Linear | **Change** | Neon read SQL helps DB-backed mindmap work; Linear optional. Don’t replace chrome-devtools — dogfood depends on it. Keep vector-store; leave DeepGraph disabled. |
| 2 | Skills lane-router + dod-report | **Keep** (lane) / **Change** (dod) | Lane-router is high-value (monorepo bleed into disclosure-rag/lab). dod-report must require chrome-devtools walk of `/research-canvas` (or spacetime), not a markdown template alone. |
| 3 | Hooks: block stash/hard-reset/force-push; wire+extend block-new-docs | **Keep** (git) / **Change** (docs/env) | Git block is mandatory after stash incident. Wire `block-new-docs.sh` yes; extending to `.env` Keep, to lockfiles **Change→narrow** (pnpm lock churn is normal here). |
| 4 | Subagents dod-auditor + security-reviewer | **Keep** (dod) / **Change** (security) | dod-auditor matches binding DoD. Security-reviewer must treat public AI routes as **known gap**, not auto-“fix by locking them” (no canvas sign-in yet). |
| 5 | Plugins security-guidance + typescript-lsp | **Change** / **Drop** | security-guidance useful if scoped to public AI + cron/processing. typescript-lsp **Drop** for this workspace — huge Next app, noisy; prefer `tsc` scoped greps as DoD already does. |
| 6 | Slim SessionStart + worktrees + Prettier scoped | **Keep** | SessionStart is the biggest cheap win; worktrees match concurrent agents; Prettier already app-scoped — don’t globalize. Note: no `GOAL.md` yet — use `apps/app/CLAUDE.md` + `git status -sb` until `/goal` creates one. |

---

## D. At most 2 better local automations

1. **`live-ai-path` PreToolUse** — deny `Write` of new files under `apps/app/src/app/api/**` unless path is one of the two live AI routes (or explicit allowlist: documents/processing/cron). Stops invented RAG/agent routes at the source.
2. **`canvas-dogfood` skill** — checklist: `bun run dev:app` → `/research-canvas` → Graph/Timeline/Search via `ViewSwitcher` + one mindmap agent turn; spacetime needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_PUBLIC_TOKEN` or mark UNVERIFIED. Wire chrome-devtools; refuse “done” without it.

---

## E. Risks if repo-wide hooks fire here

- **`block-new-docs` + user SOLID rule** — blocks new `*_PSUEDOCODE.md` / PascalCase docs agents are told to create under `apps/app`.
- **Lockfile deny** — breaks legitimate `bun`/`pnpm` dependency work across the monorepo.
- **`.env` deny on Edit** — can block adding a *documented* public env (e.g. Mapbox) when only values should be secret; deny Write of new `.env*` and secret commits, not all env edits.
- **Repo-wide Prettier** — reformats against [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc) (`bracketSpacing: false`).
- **Security auto-lock of AI routes** — breaks public research canvas until Clerk UI exists.
- **SessionStart still dumping TODO** — keeps starving real `apps/app/CLAUDE.md` context.
- **Shared worktree hooks without worktrees** — stash/reset blocks help; if agents share one tree, also need lane-router or false “clean” claims continue.

Next: decide whether to wire git-danger + slim SessionStart first (highest ROI, ~30 min), or invent-route guard.
